content.title: 2025 Election
content.summary: The 2025 City Council election in Arvada is scheduled for November 4, 2025. The city council district map, adopted in January 2023, allows residents to confirm their district by entering their address. Candidates for the council include Michael Griffith and Denise Vargas for At Large positions, Randy Moorman and Eric Bodenstab for District 1, and Rebecka Lovisone and Aaron Skoff for District 3, while Nathan Mudd will not appear on the ballot due to not filing a petition.
content.body:
**Election Day**: November 4, 2025

## City Council District Map

The [District Map](https://arvada.maps.arcgis.com/apps/instant/sidebar/index.html?appid=332a7eba6a4641999d278cfa6ee149f4) was adopted in January 2023. Locate your address on the map, or enter your address in the search box (identified by the magnifying glass near the top, left corner of the map) to confirm which City Council District you live in.
